criteria.text: A representative application group is migrated and back in service within its agreed window, with no change for its users
criteria.how: Pick a group with a database and a front end, migrate it in a test window, and time it end to end.

criteria.text: A rollback to the old platform completes within the agreed time after a failed cutover
criteria.how: Fail a test cutover on purpose and roll back, with the clock running.

criteria.text: Backups and restores work on the new platform before the first production wave
criteria.how: Back up a migrated machine on the new platform and restore it.

criteria.text: Monitoring and alerts on the new platform reach the same people as before
criteria.how: Trigger a test alert on a migrated machine and check who receives it.

criteria.text: The dependency map shows every connection of a sample application, confirmed by its owner
criteria.how: Review one application's map with its owner and look for anything missing.

readiness: A read-only account on the current platform for the inventory
A representative application group chosen, with its owner and a test window
Network reachability between old and new platform for the migration traffic
Data seeding scheduled so the cutover falls within a week of it
The rollback path written down before the first move
Backup and monitoring ready to watch the migrated machines
Licences and support dates of the current platform known
